behavior: Four read-only discovery adapters preserve Retry-After dates/numeric cooldowns on429/5xx; Greenhouse preserves the longest settled response cooldown with fixed public classification. Existing durable scheduling/retry policy respects cooldowns without a new request retry loop.

verification.environment: Isolated Windows venv; SQLAlchemy2.1.1; synthetic httpx transports and disposable SQLite files. No live provider or Redis connection used.
verification.command: python -m pytest -q tests/unit/test_source_retry_after.py tests/integration/test_source_retry_after.py tests/integration/test_source_retry_after_persistence.py tests/integration/test_greenhouse.py tests/integration/test_remotive.py tests/integration/test_remoteok.py tests/integration/test_wwr.py tests/integration/test_source_policy_cadence_sustain_021.py tests/unit/test_discovery_retry_policy.py tests/unit/test_retry_matrix_sustain_161.py --junitxml=docs/evidence/2026-11-03-webpro-89c21f-source-retry/source-tests.xml

junit.note: Includes104 passed parent/parameterized cases,125 successful subtests,2 skipped cases; not an additional test total. Hostname and absolute workspace prefixes removed.

preserved_failures.detail: Greenhouse legitimately performs two independent metadata/jobs GETs. Corrected the initial single-call test expectation before recording the actual date regression.
All four adapters ignored two-hour HTTP-date cooldowns on429/503, using60/300/86400-second fallbacks instead.
Both concurrency1/2 and429/503 showed that only the first failure cooldown survived.
Added mixed HTTPX/provider failure cooldown retention, leap-second handling, UTC-normalized fifty-year cutoff and exact durable scheduler/outbox checks.

limitations: MJ-REQ-160 remains PARTIAL; browser/AI/queue retry breadth and complete original acceptance remain open.
Two opt-in live provider checks are SKIP/NOT_RUN, not PASS.
No live provider request, paid inference, application submission or non-idempotent write replay.
Receipt-clock interpretation assumes a trustworthy UTC host clock. This patch does not introduce server-Date clock-skew correction.
Source disable thresholds and operation attempt caps remain existing policy.
Protected candidate checks, actual merge and guarded deployment remain pending at this source checkpoint.
